.]] Trinket refers to a type of armor worn in the trinket equipment slot. Trinkets are also called devices, gadgets, and other references. Trinkets are itemized unlike any other type of armor. Whereas most high level armor will give moderate bonuses to four or five of the seven or eight stats useful to your particular class, a trinket will generally provide very large bonuses to just two stats. Typically, one bonus will be a flat always-on bonus, and the other will either be a use effect (that you must activate) or a proc (which will occasionally activate whenever you attack or are hit). In a PvP context, "to trinket" refers to using a PvP trinket.

A tribe is a social unit consisting of a number of families united under a common hereditary chieftain. Typically, trolls organize in these groups, and some sources suggest tauren and taunka identify more often as tribes than clans. The term tribe is sometimes used interchangeably with the term clan. *Each individual tribe has a chief or chieftain, such as Vol'jin (Chief of the Darkspear tribe) or Cairne Bloodhoof (Chief of the Bloodhoof tribe and Chieftain of the United Tauren Tribes). *In the current structure of the Horde, all clans answer to one warchief. *Non-Horde races that form tribes include the naga. *Humans used to be organised in tribes before being united by King Thoradin of the

The Tribunal of Ages encounter consists of protecting dwarf explorer Brann Bronzebeard from waves of mobs as part of the Halls of Stone (quest) quest he gives. It is unusual in that it is a boss encounter in difficulty and in loot, but does not involve fighting a boss per se. Rather, you must only survive and protect Brann from the waves. Nevertheless, many people would find this encounter more difficult than the other three boss fights of this instance! Successfully completing this event grants access to the Tribunal Chest. The Tribunal of Ages is a false system created by Loken to cover up the crimes he had committed and is not an accurate record of historical fact.

Tricks of the Trade is a rogue class talent. It is similar to a hunter's Misdirection in which it will transfer all threat gained from the rogue's next attack and all the of the rogue's actions taken for 6 seconds after that attack to the party or raid member on which it is cast. A triangulation is an arrangement which allows one tank to be at the front at any given time, while the DPS, healers, and offtank are attacking from behind. The tank, the offtank, and a pile of DPS and healers are at 120 degree angles. This arrangement is useful for boss fights where the tanks have to take turns, but should not be stacked (either because there is a cleave, or cone spray, or just because you want the second tank to not cause parries). This arrangement is less useful if the raid must remain mobile or dodge ground effects. It is also less useful if the boss must be moved/kited periodically.

Trent Hayward is one of five Hayward brothers that own and operate the Hayward Fishery in Gilneas. The Trench of the Enders is a valley underneath the bridges that connect to the Archivam, between Archivam and the Edge of Sin. It is part of the Endmire, though does not connect to the rest of it. There is an elevator connecting to the Halls of Atonement here, which contains a Venthyr Covenant Transportation Network mirror.
Trem is a tortollan located in northern Exile's Reach. He is found in a secret underwater cave under a waterfall.

The Tremaculum is the northwestern corner of the Maw. Bordered to the east and south by the Planes of Torment, and the southwest by the Ruin's Cradle, the Tremaculum holds some of the Jailer's more important prisoners before they get transferred to Torghast, Tower of the Damned. A Chaotic Riftstone to the Crucible of the Damned is available once players unlock it with the Encased Riftwalker Essence. Here souls are tormented, twisted into wretched shades.The Lion's Cage

Treasures of Korthia is awarded to players who find all 10 treasures scattered about Korthia and Desmotaeron in the Maw. This achievement is one of many for the meta-achievement Breaking the Chains.

With this item, completing world quests and daily quests in the Shadowlands' four main zones awards additional reputation.
